:::{#def-homogeneous-function}
#### Homogeneous function

A [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f: \reals^p \to \reals^m$ is **homogeneous**
[@wikipedia_linear_map]
if it preserves [scalar multiplication](#def-scalar-mult):
[for all](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-universal-quantifier) $\vx \in \reals^p$ and $c \in \reals$,

$$f(c\vx) = c f(\vx)$$

:::
